title: PartitionRecord v1 — one task's standing across a partition: who offered it, every claimant the mesh has recorded (one per side while split, one mesh-wide while whole), how many terminal executions the task has produced, the single answer's claimant and status once one stands (null until then), the claimants whose executions were reconciled as duplicates (retained and named, never delivered as answers), the task's status — open, claimed, answered (an answer stands), or reconciled (healing settled duplicate executions) — and whether a standing answer is still provisional because the mesh is split and healing has not yet confirmed it; identifiers, names, and counts only, never payload content (Y-058)
